# Segmentation settings QC - 

Here, we used different settings for deep-learning based single-cell segmentation (see `RCC_steinbock_prepro.md`). 

Mesmer:
**masks_1** = *Irdium 191/193,* CA9, panCK, Vimentin, SMA, CD8a, CD68   
**masks_2** = *Irdium 191/193,* CA9, panCK, Vimentin, SMA, CD8a, CD68, CD3, Vimentin, HLADR

Nuclear detection and expansion:
**masks_exp** = *Irdium 191/193,* + Expansion by maximum of 3 pixels

CellPose: 
**masks_cp_1** = *Irdium 191/193,* CA9, panCK, Vimentin, SMA, CD8a, CD68  

## Software requirements

```{r lib, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#Data containers
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

#Data processing
library(CATALYST)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(imcRtools)

#Data visualization
library(cytomapper)
library(dittoSeq)
library(viridis)

#Utilities
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(stringr)
library(BiocParallel)
```

## Read in images

Note: The multi-channel images are saved as 32-bit images while the segmentation masks are
saved as 16-bit images. To correctly scale pixel values of the segmentation
masks when reading them in set `as.is = TRUE`.

```{r read-images}
#Load images
images <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img/",on_disk = TRUE,h5FilesPath = "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img/",BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 14,progressbar = TRUE,stop.on.error = FALSE))

#Load masks
masks_1 <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/masks_1/", as.is = TRUE)
masks_2 <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/masks_2/", as.is = TRUE)
masks_exp <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/masks_exp/", as.is = TRUE)
masks_cp_1 <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/masks_cp_1/", as.is = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Safety checks
all.equal(names(images), names(masks_1))
all.equal(names(images), names(masks_2))
all.equal(names(images), names(masks_exp))
all.equal(names(images), names(masks_cp_1))
```


```{r}
# Set channel-names for multi-channel images
panel <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/panel.csv")

channelNames(images) <- panel$clean_target

images
```

Add additional metadata to the `elementMetadata` slot of the `CytoImageList` (accessible via mcols)

```{r add-image-metadata}
# Read in external metadata
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(paste0(patient_meta$grid,"x",patient_meta$x,"y",patient_meta$y),"NA","")
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(patient_meta$TMA_id, "x","X")
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(patient_meta$TMA_id, "y","Y")

# Read in images
images_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/images.csv",col_names = TRUE)
images_meta$names <- str_split(images_meta$image,".tiff",simplify = TRUE)[,1]
images_meta$TMA_id <- str_split(images_meta$acquisition_description," ",simplify = TRUE)[,1]

# Add information to metadata of CytoImageList
mcols(images)$sample_id <- images_meta$names[match(names(images),images_meta$names)]
mcols(images)$TMA_id <- images_meta$TMA_id[match(names(images),images_meta$names)]

mcols(images)$PID <- patient_meta$PID[match(mcols(images)$TMA_id,patient_meta$TMA_id)]
mcols(images)$type <- patient_meta$type[match(mcols(images)$TMA_id,patient_meta$TMA_id)]
mcols(images)$subtype <- patient_meta$subtype[match(mcols(images)$TMA_id,patient_meta$TMA_id)]

# Transfer to masks objects as well
mcols(masks_1) <- mcols(masks_2) <- mcols(masks_exp) <- mcols(masks_cp_1) <- mcols(images)
```

## Segmentation quality control - A

A: Using `cytoviewer`

```{r}
library(cytoviewer)

cur_masks <- masks_1[mcols(masks_1)$sample_id %in% mcols(cur_images)$sample_id]

cytoviewer(image = cur_images, mask = cur_masks, img_id = "sample_id")

names(cur_images)
```

B: `plotPixels` function from [cytomapper](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/cytomapper.html).

```{r overlay-masks, message=FALSE}
# Subset to ccRCC 
images <- images[!is.na(mcols(images)$subtype)]
images_ccRCC <- images[mcols(images)$subtype == "clear_cell_RCC"]

#Randomly select 30 images
set.seed(220195)
img_random <- sample(seq_len(length(images_ccRCC)), 30)

# Normalize and clip image
cur_images <- images_ccRCC[img_random]
cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, separateImages = TRUE)
cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, inputRange = c(0, 0.2))

# Generate and save images
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores = 20)

masks_options <- c("masks_1", "masks_2", "masks_exp", "masks_cp_1")

foreach(i = masks_options)%dopar%{

# Subset masks
cur_masks <- get(i)
cur_masks <- cur_masks[mcols(cur_masks)$sample_id %in% mcols(cur_images)$sample_id]
cur_masks <- cur_masks[match(names(cur_images), names(cur_masks))]

plotPixels(cur_images,
           mask = cur_masks,
           img_id = "sample_id",
           colour_by = c("DNA1", "CA9", "SMA","CD8a","CD68"),
           colour = list("DNA1" = c("black", "yellow"),
                         "CA9" = c("black", "magenta"),
                         "SMA" = c("black", "cyan"),
                         "CD8a" = c("black","red"),
                         "CD68" = c("black","green")
                         ),
           thick = FALSE,
           image_title = NULL,
           legend = list(colour_by.title.cex = 0.7,
                         colour_by.labels.cex = 0.7),
           save_plot = list(filename = paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/seg_test/", i,".png"), scale = 2))
}
```

## Function to remove artificial pixels 

```{r}
library(cytomapper)
library(EBImage)
#Artifacts: 
#202207_TMA224.1_BlockB_SE_106.tiff
#202207_TMA224.1_BlockA_SE_075.tiff
#202207_TMA224.1_BlockB_SE_069.tiff

#Normal images: 

cur_img <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img/202209_TMA224.1_BlockC_SE_059.tiff")
channelNames(cur_img) <- paste0("ch", 1:dim(cur_img[[1]])[3])

# Visualize artefacts
plotPixels(cur_img, colour_by = "ch1", bcg = list(ch1 = c(0, 10, 1)))
plotPixels(cur_img, colour_by = "ch2", bcg = list(ch2 = c(0, 10, 1)))
plotPixels(cur_img, colour_by = "ch10", bcg = list(ch10 = c(0, 10, 1)))

# Step 1: Detect artefacts by log-variance-mean-ratio
cur_var <- apply(as.array(cur_img[[1]]), MARGIN = c(1,2), var)
cur_mean <- apply(as.array(cur_img[[1]]), MARGIN = c(1,2), mean)
cur_median <- apply(as.array(cur_img[[1]]), MARGIN = c(1,2), mean)

plot(log(cur_mean), log(cur_var/(cur_mean^2)))
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

max(cur_median)

hist(cur_median, ylim = c(0,2000))
abline(v = 15, col = "red")

pixels_wrong_2 <- cur_median > 15
pixels_wrong_2[is.na(pixels_wrong_2)] <- FALSE

pixels_wrong <- log(cur_var/(cur_mean^2)) < 0
pixels_wrong[is.na(pixels_wrong)] <- FALSE

sum(pixels_wrong_2)
sum(pixels_wrong)

if(sum(pixels_wrong) > 0){
  print(paste0(names(cur_img),": This image contained ", sum(pixels_wrong), " artificial pixels."))
}

display(pixels_wrong)

# Step 2: Set all artefact pixels to 0
img_1 <- cur_img[[1]]
img_1[pixels_wrong] <- 0

display(img_1)

# Step 3: Replace artefact pixels by median
img_median <- medianFilter(img_1, size = 1)

img_1[test_img] <- img_median[test_img]

display(img_1)


# # By Otsu thresholding
# threshold <- otsu(as.array(cur_mean), range = c(0,max(cur_mean)))
# 
# hist(cur_mean)
# abline(v = otsu(as.array(cur_mean), range = c(0,max(cur_mean))), col = "red")
# pixels_wrong <- cur_mean > threshold
# 
# display(pixels_wrong)
# 
# ## Compare between two methods
true_positives <- sum(pixels_wrong & pixels_wrong_2)
false_positives <- sum(!pixels_wrong & pixels_wrong_2)
true_negatives <- sum(!pixels_wrong & !pixels_wrong_2)
false_negatives <- sum(pixels_wrong & !pixels_wrong_2)

conf_matrix <- matrix(c(true_positives, false_positives, false_negatives, true_negatives),
                      nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                      dimnames = list(Actual = c("Positive", "Negative"),
                                      Predicted = c("Positive", "Negative")))

conf_matrix
```

```{r}
library(BiocNeighbors)
library(BiocParallel)
library(tidyverse)

images <- cur_images 
cutoff = 0
size = 2
x = 1

removePixelArtefacts <- function(images,
                         cutoff = 0,
                         size = 2,
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam()){
  bplapply(seq_along(images), function(x){ 
    
    # Step 1: Detect artefacts by log-variance-mean-ratio
    cur_var <- apply(as.array(images[[x]]), MARGIN = c(1,2), var)
    cur_mean <- apply(as.array(images[[x]]), MARGIN = c(1,2), mean)
    
    pixels_wrong <- log(cur_var/(cur_mean^2)) < cutoff
    pixels_wrong[is.na(pixels_wrong)] <- FALSE

    if (sum(pixels_wrong) > 0) {
      print(paste0(names(images[x]),": This image contained ", sum(pixels_wrong), " artificial pixels."))
    }
    
    # Step 2: Set all artefact pixels to 0
    img_cor <- CytoImageList(images[x], on_disk = FALSE)[[1]] #Load images into memory
    img_cor[pixels_wrong] <- 0
    
    #Step 3: Replace artefact pixels with median filter 
    img_median <- medianFilter(img_cor, size = size)
    img_cor[pixels_wrong] <- img_median[pixels_wrong]
    
    writeImage(as.array(img_cor)/(2^16 - 1), 
             paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img_cor/",names(images[x]), ".tiff"),
             bits.per.sample = 16)
    
    }, BPPARAM = BPPARAM)
  }
  

# cur_out <- as(cur_out, "CytoImageList") 
  # names(cur_out) <- names(images)
  # mcols(cur_out) <- mcols(images)
  #    
  # return(cur_out)


# test for in-memory images
img_out_test <- removePixelArtefacts(cur_img)
img_out_test

#test for on-disk images
removePixelArtefacts(cur_images[4])


writeImage(as.array(img_out_test[[1]])/(2^16 - 1), 
             paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img_cor/", names(img_cor[1]), ".tiff"),
             bits.per.sample = 16)

writeImage(as.array(img_out_test[[1]])/(2^16 - 1), 
             paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img_cor/", names(img_out_test[1]), ".tiff"),
             bits.per.sample = 16)
```
